glosses: A cohesive whole built up of distinct parts.

examples.text: The birds had built an amazing structure out of sticks and various discarded items.

The original family who had begun to build a palace to rival Nonesuch had died out before they had put up little more than the gateway, so that the actual structure which had come down to posterity retained the secret magic of a promise rather than the overpowering splendour of a great architectural achievement.

glosses: The underlying shape of a solid.

examples.text: He studied the structure of her face.

glosses: The overall form or organization of something.

examples.text: The structure of a sentence.
The structure of the society was still a mystery.

Drawings and pictures are more than mere ornaments in scientific discourse. Blackboard sketches, geological maps, diagrams of molecular structure, astronomical photographs, MRI images, the many varieties of statistical charts and graphs: These pictorial devices are indispensable tools for presenting evidence, for explaining a theory, for telling a story.

glosses: A set of rules defining behaviour.

examples.text: For some, the structure of school life was oppressive.

glosses: Several pieces of data treated as a unit.

examples.text: This structure contains both date and timezone information.

examples.text: There's lots of structure to be fished along the west shore of the lake; the impoundment submerged a town there when it was built.

glosses: A body, such as a political party, with a cohesive purpose or outlook.

examples.text: The South African leader went off to consult with the structures.

glosses: A set along with a collection of finitary functions and relations.

examples.text: I'm trying to structure my time better so I'm not always late.

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: A cohesive whole built up of distinct parts.

examples.text: The birds had built an amazing structure out of sticks and various discarded items.

The original family who had begun to build a palace to rival Nonesuch had died out before they had put up little more than the gateway, so that the actual structure which had come down to posterity retained the secret magic of a promise rather than the overpowering splendour of a great architectural achievement.

glosses: The underlying shape of a solid.

examples.text: He studied the structure of her face.

glosses: The overall form or organization of something.

examples.text: The structure of a sentence.
The structure of the society was still a mystery.

Drawings and pictures are more than mere ornaments in scientific discourse. Blackboard sketches, geological maps, diagrams of molecular structure, astronomical photographs, MRI images, the many varieties of statistical charts and graphs: These pictorial devices are indispensable tools for presenting evidence, for explaining a theory, for telling a story.

glosses: A set of rules defining behaviour.

examples.text: For some, the structure of school life was oppressive.

glosses: Several pieces of data treated as a unit.

examples.text: This structure contains both date and timezone information.

glosses: Underwater terrain or objects (such as a dead tree or a submerged car) that tend to attract fish

examples.text: There's lots of structure to be fished along the west shore of the lake; the impoundment submerged a town there when it was built.

glosses: A body, such as a political party, with a cohesive purpose or outlook.

examples.text: The South African leader went off to consult with the structures.

glosses: A set along with a collection of finitary functions and relations.
To give structure to; to arrange.

examples.text: I'm trying to structure my time better so I'm not always late.
I've structured the deal to limit the amount of money we can lose.

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: Ossature porteuse d’un édifice bâti, d'une construction mécanique.

examples.text: Posée sur douze vérins en appui sur la structure de la tour, la plate-forme de déconstruction permet à des engins de petite taille pourvus de pince de grignotage d’intervenir, avec un faible impact environnemental.

glosses: Organisation des constituants d’un système, architecture.

examples.text: L’humus qui, lié aux argiles, contribue à la qualité de la structure des sols et à leur fertilité, résulte de la transformation de la matière organique.

On peut en conclure que les perméants hydrophiles utilisés ne donnent pas lieu à une adsorption sensible sur les structures musculaires (auquel cas R aurait une tendance à augmenter dans le domaine des concentrations faibles).
La structure d’un discours, d’un poème.
La structure du parti communiste tchécoslovaque est fondée sur des cellules locales, fédérées au niveau cantonal puis régional.

glosses: Ensemble combiné avec un ou plusieurs objets relatifs à cet ensemble (comme des lois de composition), satisfaisant un certain nombre de propriétés.

examples.text: Une structure algébrique.
La structure de groupe.
structure différentielle

glosses: Organisation du réseau régulier de maillons élémentaires.

examples.text: La structure d'un cristal.

glosses: Arrangement, agencement, organisation entre différents éléments.

examples.text: La structure d'une entreprise.

glosses: Ensemble formel de relations, idée centrale du paradigme épistémologique structuraliste.

examples.text: La structure de l'ensemble ne sort jamais indemne de la modification d'une de ses parties.

glosses: Harmonie globale.

examples.text: La structure d'un vin est son aptitude, en bouche, à solliciter harmonieusement l'ensemble des récepteurs sensoriels.

glosses: Proportions des différents âges, diamètres ou catégories des arbres dans une forêt traitée en futaie irrégulière.

examples.text: Leur application est toutefois modulée en fonction de la structure et du capital des peuplements en place qui peuvent être assez éloignés de l’équilibre que sous-entend la mise en œuvre de ce traitement.

glosses: Première personne du singulier de l’indicatif présent du verbe structurer.
Troisième personne du singulier de l’indicatif présent du verbe structurer.
Première personne du singulier du subjonctif présent du verbe structurer.
Troisième personne du singulier du subjonctif présent du verbe structurer.
Deuxième personne du singulier de l’impératif du verbe structurer.

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: complesso di componenti che sostengono l'armatura di qualcosa
l'insieme di superfici, edifici predisposti per una specifica funzione
complesso di oggetti matematici addizionali per mettere in evidenza un insieme
successione ordinata e logica, anche di eventi e/o episodi

examples.text: struttura della storia

tutto il complesso dell’opera filosofica di Hegel verte sulla concezione di una “struttura scheletrica” che poi viene pressoché adattata alle categorie applicate secondo la triade logica di “tesi, antitesi e sintesi”

glosses: terza persona singolare dell'indicativo presente di strutturare
seconda persona singolare dell'imperativo presente di strutturare

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: de interne opmaak van een geheel

examples.text: Wat is de structuur van dat blad?

glosses: de manier waarop een samengesteld geheel is opgebouwd

examples.text: Ik was altijd een efficiënte planner geweest en hield van structuur, orde en controle.

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: stały układ i wzajemne relacje elementów stanowiących całość

examples.text: Przez cały rok policja usiłowała rozgryźć strukturę siatki przestępczej.
Azotki glinu, galu i indu przyjmują diamentopodobną strukturę wurcytu, w której atomy zajmują tetraedryczne położenia.

"Antropolodzy mają prawo twierdzić, że przyczynili się do zachowania kulturowego dziedzictwa społeczeństw, które badali, […]. Lecz prawdą jest również, iż mieli oni swój udział, czasem tylko pośredni, w utrzymywaniu struktur władzy reprezentowanych przez system kolonialny"

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: algo constituído de partes distintas
partes de um corpo responsáveis pela sua resistência e/ou sustentação
o modo como partes organizadas se relacionam

examples.text: A estrutura da frase.
A estrutura da sociedade ainda é um mistério.

glosses: modo de organização, construção e arranjo dos tecidos ou órgãos
a composição de uma rocha, em oposição à sua textura
a maneira pelo qual os átomos se organizam em uma molécula
o sistema de relações entre os grupos constituintes de uma sociedade
o padrão de organização de uma língua como um todo ou os relacionamentos entre seus elementos constituintes (como morfemas, fonemas, etc)

lista de atribuições, contendo geralmente um universo de discurso, para os diversos sinais que constituem o alfabeto de um sistema lógico, de modo que sejam associados a todas as fórmulas deste sistema valores veritativos; modelo; interpretação

translations.source_sense_description: Mathematik: Menge mit bestimmten Eigenschaften

glosses: внутреннее устройство, компоненты объекта вместе с их взаимосвязями

examples.text: Структура правительства.
Оксалаты кальция второго типа имеют мелкозернистую, беспорядочную структуру, часто с органическими включениями.

glosses: тип данных: совокупность нескольких переменных (или констант) разного типа
учреждение, организация, орган, ведомство и т. п., имеющие определённое строение, устройство

examples.text: Государственные структуры оказались неэффективными.

glosses: совокупность связей между частями объекта

examples.text: Диалектический материализм рассматривает категорию структуры как одну из важных в современном познании.

glosses: неоднородный материал, обладающий сложным строением

Armadura, generalmente de acero u hormigón armado, que, fija al suelo, sirve de sustentación a un edificio.

examples.text: Státní správa zajišťuje mnoho úkonů a má proto složitou strukturu.

examples.text: Dýchání rostlin zajišťují buněčné struktury na listech, zvané průduchy.
